description:
About Me & Our Team We are building a web dashboard to remotely control soil exploration rovers and monitor their real-time telemetry and ground data.

My Skills: Python (Flask, SQLite, NumPy), Java, Kotlin (Android), Git.

Looking For:

Frontend / UI-UX Designer (for the dashboard UI)

Data / GIS Specialist (for NASA soil datasets)

Pitch Deck / Presentation Lead (for final video & slides)

Join us if you are into robotics, space, and web development!
